gloss: pale color; light color; pastel shade

definitions.gloss: pale color; light color; pastel shade; soft hue
definitions.explanation: A soft, muted, or light shade of color. Used to describe colors that are not vivid or saturated — pastels, washed-out tones, and delicate hues found in nature, fashion, and art.

examples.japanese: {淡|あわ}い{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: To wear a dress in a pale color.
In spring, there are many flowers in pale colors.
Painting the walls in a pale color makes the room look larger.

notes:
A common aesthetic expression combining the i-adjective ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧ (pale, light, faint) with ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). The adjective ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧ has a broader meaning of "faint" or "fleeting" (as in ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧, faint hope), but in this compound it specifically describes color intensity.

Pale and pastel colors hold a special place in Japanese aesthetics, associated with refinement, femininity, and the delicate beauty of nature — particularly cherry blossoms (⟦{桜色|さくらいろ}→桜色：15614_sakurairo⟧) and spring landscapes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧⟦{色合|いろあ}い→色合い：13950_iroai⟧: pale coloring, soft tones
- ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧: pale pink
- ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧⟦{水色|みずいろ}→水色：15336_mizuiro⟧: pale light blue
- {淡|あわ}い{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes in pale colors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パステル⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧: pastel colors — loanword, same concept
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: light/thin color — similar but focuses on low saturation
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: vivid color — the opposite of pale
